content:
jason: Heads up — bringing up orchid18b (18B) on canary. Ran int4 quant with KV prefetch; seeing intermittent OOMs on p3x and a small but consistent quality drop on summarization evals. attaching logs.

jason: ```
[2026-03-20 09:12:34] ERROR CUDA OOM allocating 1.2G (device 0)
runtime: infer/kv_cache_alloc.cpp:142
model: orchid18b-int4-prefetch
cmd: ./serve --model orchid18b --quant int4 --prefetch 64 --max_new_tokens 512
```

priya: on it. can you paste the eval deltas and quick memory numbers?

jason: quick eval-bot summary: rougeL delta -1.9, exact_match -2.3, avg_latency +15ms. observed p99 GPU memory spike ~43GB (instance GPU = 40GB) leading to OOMs under high QPS.

alex: likely KV cache fragmentation + overzealous prefetch. int4 reduces weight storage but KV still grows with seq_len*batch. prefetch window 64 is too aggressive for 18B int4 on 40GB. two quick levers: lower max_new_tokens default and reduce prefetch_window. also try MALLOC_ARENA_MAX to limit host allocator arenas.

megan: proposal for canary rollback-safe patch:
- set default max_new_tokens = 256 (was 512) for orchid18b canary route
- prefetch_window -> 32
- cap continuous batching batch_size <= 2 for canary
- set env: export MALLOC_ARENA_MAX=4 on canary hosts
- add automatic fallback path: if eval regression > 1.5% on rougeL, switch canary model to int8 variant

jason: applying changes now. will also disable unlimited prefetch on canary and add batch_size cap in router config. pushing config diff.

infra-bot: Deploy job started: canary/orchid18b/2026-03-20-09:20 (job id c-2190). link: https://ci.redwood.internal/jobs/c-2190

eval-bot: quick after-patch run (2k prompts): rougeL delta now -0.7 vs baseline, exact_match -0.9, p99 latency -10ms, peak GPU mem 38.5GB, no OOMs observed. perf: throughput stable.

priya: excellent. schedule full canary sweep overnight across regions. also add a dedicated run comparing int4 vs int8 quality on our 200k eval set.

megan: follow-ups: sweep prefetch_window in {16,32,48} and batch_size in {1,2,4}, measure fragmentation via vm_peak and device fragmentation metric, and add metric to console for KV allocation churn.

jason: created ticket INC-7421 with config diffs, logs, and quick evals. will iterate on prefetch sweep tomorrow and post results here. thanks all :rocket:
